en.t: I hear you coughed up blood.

units.source_text: 堀木在我面前盤腿坐下，說道。

en.t: Horiki sat cross legged in front of me and said this.

units.source_text: 他的臉上浮現出我從未見過的親切微笑，

en.t: A kind smile I had never seen before appeared on his face,

units.source_text: 那微笑讓我感激，又讓我歡喜，我不禁背過臉，淚流滿面。

en.t: That smile filled me with gratitude and joy, and without thinking I turned my face away and burst into tears.

units.source_text: 而且，僅僅是因為他親切的微笑，我便被徹底打敗，被徹底埋葬了。

en.t: And simply because of that kind smile of his, I was utterly defeated and utterly buried.
I was put into a car.

units.source_text: 「你必須得先住院治療，其他的事情由我們來辦就行了。」

en.t: First you have to go into the hospital for treatment; we will take care of everything else.

units.source_text: 比目魚用平靜的語氣勸著我（那是足以用大慈悲來形容的平靜語氣），

en.t: Flatfish urged me in a calm tone, a calm so deep it could almost be called great compassion,

units.source_text: 我彷彿是一個缺乏意志力和判斷力的人，抽抽搭搭地哭泣，

en.t: as though I were someone without willpower or judgment, sobbing and sniffling,

units.source_text: 唯唯諾諾地聽從他們倆的吩咐。

en.t: and meekly obeyed the two of them.
